title: Annealed Underdamped Langevin Dynamics
summary: In sampling, different flavours of annealing, tempering, or other successive approximation approaches are widely used and studied. In this work we investigate annealed underdamped Langevin sampling for logconcave distributions of the form $π(x) \propto e^{-Ψ(x)}$ for a potential $Ψ:\mathbb{R}^d \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$. That is, we assume access to the score of a general approximating family of distributions $(π_τ)_{τ\in [0,1]}$ with $π_0=π$.
